environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. DynamoDB table 'UserTokens' uses a simple partition key (PK) and sort key (SK). The ECS task role has dynamodb:GetItem and dynamodb:PutItem permissions on both tables with no condition keys. The ALB forwards all POST requests to the service without rate limiting. CloudWatch logs are enabled but no alerting is configured on error rate patterns.

config.alb_config: default listener rules, no WAF attached
